name: Data extraction & chaining
description: Capture a value from one response and reuse it in later requests.

login.name: Login (extract token)
login.description: Stores the returned token in a collection variable for the next request.

use-token.name: Use the extracted token
use-token.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('profile is returned', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json()).to.have.property('email'); });
use-token.description: Reuses {{authToken}} captured by the Login request.

pre-request.name: Pre-request script sets a value
pre-request.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('trace header was sent', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json()).to.have.property('x-trace'); });
pre-request.description: A pre-request script computes a value that the request then sends as a header.
